title.ko: 문어체 도치: Not only did ... · Under no circumstances · So ... that · Such was · Little did ... know
title.en: literary inversion: not only did, under no circumstances, so ... that, such was, little did ... know

explain.ko: 부정이나 제한의 의미를 가진 부사(never, rarely, hardly, no sooner, only then, not only, under no circumstances)가 문장 앞에 오면 조동사가 주어 앞으로 이동하는 도치가 일어납니다. 이 구조는 문어체에서 극적인 효과와 강조를 만듭니다. 또한 so ... that과 such ... that에서도 Such was his anger that ...처럼 도치가 가능합니다. 일반 대화에서는 어색할 수 있으므로 문학, 연설, 격식 있는 글에서 쓰세요.
explain.en: When an adverb with negative or restrictive meaning (never, rarely, hardly, no sooner, only then, not only, under no circumstances) opens a sentence, the auxiliary moves before the subject. This inversion creates drama and emphasis in written style. Inversion is also possible with so ... that and such ... that, as in Such was his anger that ... Because it can sound stilted in conversation, reserve it for literature, speeches and formal writing.

lines.t: Inversion gives force to literary prose. When a negative or restrictive adverb opens a sentence, the auxiliary moves before the subject. The structure is especially effective in fiction and speeches, but it can sound stilted in everyday conversation.

trans.ko: 도치는 문어체에서 문장에 힘을 주는 장치입니다. 부정이나 제한의 부사가 문장 앞에 오면 조동사가 주어 앞으로 이동합니다. 이 구조는 소설과 연설에서 특히 효과적이지만, 일상 대화에서는 어색할 수 있습니다.

prompt.ko: 부정 부사 도치(never, only then, not only, no sooner)를 사용해 극적인 순간을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences describing a dramatic moment using negative-adverb inversion (never, only then, not only, no sooner).

task.model: No sooner had I entered the building than I felt an eerie silence. Never before had I known such a quiet place. Only then did I realise something was wrong. Little did I know what was coming.

model_trans.ko: 나는 그 건물에 들어서자마자 이상한 정적을 느꼈어요. 그렇게 조용한 곳은 본 적이 없었어요. 그제야 나는 무언가 잘못됐음을 깨달았어요. 어떤 일이 닥칠지는 전혀 몰랐어요.
model_trans.en: No sooner had I entered the building than I felt an eerie silence. Never before had I known such a quiet place. Only then did I realise something was wrong. Little did I know what was coming.
